watchedbyadrien/michael-2026.text:
is this better than bohemian rhapsody? yes. but that’s not saying much.

so is it a good film? the short answer is no. this is pretty much by the book. a step by step biopic with no visual language, no insight, no depth. it’s all surface level, just a chain of events and a chain of musical hits, moving from one moment to the next without ever really digging into anything. you don’t learn anything new, you don’t feel like you understand him more. it just exists. it’s clean, safe, and ultimately forgettable cinema.

and yet… i had a great time! smiling from ear to ear.

now how is that possible? maybe I don’t say this enough on my channel. probably because it sounds too obvious or cliche. but michael jackson is in the top 5 greatest artists of all time. so great and so important in my early life that I had brushed it to the side these past few years. almost forgotten. his collaboration with quincy jones is one of the greatest runs in music history. he is exactly as great as people say he is. not overrated, not underrated, just perfectly rated as the utter musical genius he was.

and today, listening to the catalog again, in the context of his life, for the first time in a long time, I was reminded of this phenomenon we will probably never see the like again. reminded how insane his craft actually was and how no one has ever surpassed it. none of that is because the film did anything special but because it simply exists.

so no, this isn’t a good film by any means. but if its goal is to show a new generation just how uniquely unbelievable MJ was, then in a strange way, it has worth.

also, Jaafar Jackson KILLED it! in every single way.

sethsreviews/michael-2026.text: It's frictionless and absent of any creativity. It is a 2-hour showreel with no time for introspection or want to explore anything further. Just stage reenactments. Obviously the music is brilliant - it’s Michael Jackson! But I see no real point to this. Well, it’s made over a billion dollars, so I guess there’s that. Always money to be made with these things.
